emotional_tone: Approachable, Trustworthy, Optimistic, Playful, Mystical (for astrology)

typography.instructions: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Implement heavy weight contrast (font-black for headings, font-medium for body).

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6 to p-12) to feel approachable and uncluttered. Use bento grids for dashboards.
layout_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards/buttons to fit the Vibrant Play archetype

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-slate-100 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
surface_styles.astrology_glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-indigo-500/20 shadow-2xl rounded-3xl
surface_styles.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-amber-50/80 border-b border-amber-200/50

components_instructions.buttons: Chunky, rounded-full, px-6 py-3 font-bold transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 active:translate-y-0 shadow-sm
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, DatePicker. Make inputs rounded-xl, bg-white, with subtle focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500).
components_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react with bold strokes (strokeWidth={2.5}) to match the playful vibe.
components_instructions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for the 'Books & Activities' ticker on the Parent Dashboard.
components_instructions.tables: Use Shadcn Table for Principal Dashboard but style with alternating row colors (bg-slate-50) and rounded container.

animations.interactions: Hover lifts (-translate-y-1), gentle scaling (scale-105) for cards and buttons.
animations.astrology_reveal: Use framer-motion to reveal the astrology result card with a glowing drop-shadow and slow fade-in.

hero_landing.description: Child reading a colorful book, use for main hero section on landing page

books_activities.description: Children reading together, use in parent dashboard or recommendations section

astrology_bg.description: Star cluster/space, use as a dark background overlay for the Western Astrology form section

principal_dashboard.description: Teacher lecturing, use in the principal dashboard overview or school landing page

auth_bg.description: Colorful abstract background, use for login/signup split screen side image

sections: Hero Section (Image on right, Bold CTA, bg-amber-50)
Features Grid (Role-based logins: Parent, Teacher, Principal)
Astrology Teaser (Dark cosmic section mapping out niche finding)

auth.layout: Split screen. Left: Abstract auth_bg with text overlay. Right: Sign In / Sign Up form with Role Selection Tabs (Parent, Teacher, Principal).

astrology_form.layout: Centered large card with glassmorphism over astrology_bg. Fields: Name, Place (City Search), Date/Time of Birth. Submit button triggers an AI suggestion screen.
astrology_form.result_view: Cosmic result card displaying the AI-suggested Niche. Prominent 'Connect on WhatsApp' button (bg-green-500).

parent_dashboard.layout: Bento Grid Layout. Sidebar nav. Main content: Child Profile Card, Astrology Niche Card, Recommended Books (Marquee/Carousel), Suggested Activities List categorized by subject.

teacher_dashboard.layout: Standard Admin Layout. Top stats cards (Students, Classes). Table for students view, File upload/Content sharing section.

principal_dashboard.layout: Dense Control Room Grid. Key metrics (Enrollment, Teacher Perf). Charts for school-wide overview using Recharts.

testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='role-select-parent', data-testid='astrology-submit-button').
